description: Defines the NtlmBufferWriter class for bounds-checked buffer operations in NTLM protocol implementation, including methods for writing various data types, security buffers, and NTLM message components.

classes.name: NtlmBufferWriter
classes.description: A class providing bounds-checked write operations to an internal buffer for NTLM message construction.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer in little endian to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer in little endian to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer in little endian to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteFlags
methods.description: Writes NTLM negotiate flags as a 32-bit unsigned value.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes a span of bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteZeros
methods.description: Writes a specified number of zero bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Writes an NTLM security buffer structure.

methods.name: WriteAvPairHeader
methods.description: Writes an AV pair header with specified ID and length.

methods.name: WriteAvPairTerminator
methods.description: Writes a zero-length AV pair to signal end of list.

methods.name: WriteAvPair
methods.description: Writes an AV pair with payload to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUtf8String
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit character string to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUtf16AsUtf8String
methods.description: Converts UTF16 string to UTF8 and writes to buffer.

methods.name: WriteUtf8AsUtf16String
methods.description: Converts UTF8 string to UTF16 LE and writes to buffer.

methods.name: WriteUtf16String
methods.description: Writes a UTF16 LE string to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteMessageType
methods.description: Writes the message type as a uint32.

methods.name: WriteMessageHeader
methods.description: Writes NTLM message header with signature and message type.
